scope: Justified status refinements based on current project-owned README/release sources. No status patch is staged for the already-updated Vandal Hearts or other duplicate project rows.

fields.status: The live README’s generated counter reports 11,389/11,389 functions and 2,238,108/2,238,108 code bytes matched, including 108 exact hand-written assembly primitives. Its prose still calls matching close to finished and describes several remaining nonmatching large or floor-constrained functions, so the progress counter and narrative do not fully agree. Separate progress bars show 4,385/11,386 functions (38.5%) converted to readable C++ and 10,595/11,328 matched translation units (93.5%) linked into the Windows PC port; the port is not at the same completion level as the byte-match counter.

sources.label: Maintainer README: live progress counters and matching-status explanation

updates.evidence_note: The README currently displays all-functions/all-code-size progress at 100% but later says matching is close to finished and some ordinary functions remain NONMATCHING. It explicitly says 108 hand-written assembly primitives count only when byte-checked. The patch records this source-level discrepancy rather than upgrading the project to unqualified completion.

fields.status: Early and incomplete. The October 2026 README reports boot through menus and complete 1v1 CPU matches through results; Classic, Training, and Home-Run Contest have only scripted-input testing, and Adventure reaches its intro while its map and fights are untested. Team/Squad/Tourney modes, 3–8 player play, and Stage Builder editing are untested; online play is unavailable. Automated controller tests use virtual devices only, so physical pads are unconfirmed. A clean-clone build and scripted match are verified; matching decompilation is paused, and Linux/Steam Deck have not started.

sources.label: Maintainer README: October 2026 compatibility and testing matrix

updates.evidence_note: The source README has a more detailed October 2026 status matrix than the Oct 15 catalog entry, including Adventure reachability, virtual-only controller tests, clean-clone build verification, paused matching decompilation, and Linux/Steam Deck not started.

fields.status: Latest release v0.8.1 (2026-10-13) publishes an Android APK; Android requires ARM64, Vulkan, and Android 9+. iPhone/iPad and Apple Silicon Mac builds are produced locally through PadMint from the user’s disc; tvOS is only an experimental preview. Android Original gameplay with a Razer Kishi was accepted on Pixel 9 Pro XL; the current iPad release candidate has accepted controller/menu checks, not broad device coverage.
